test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is Irritation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's consider each option-

 
 
• Abhorrence- A feeling of revulsion; disgusted loathing.
 
• Irritation- **The state of feeling annoyed**, impatient, or slightly angry. 
 
• Ebullience- The quality of being cheerful and full of energy; exuberance.
 
• Hatred- Intense dislike; hate.
 
 
 
• Hence 'irritation' is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.
 
• Thus option 2 is the correct answer.

 

Correct sentence: The two boys were not allowed to go to the market, but they wanted to. This was a source of great irritation to the boys.
